sc_owner.text: Frothy coffee, a jukebox and a row of scooters outside. That was the mod's idea of a good night. Plus the clothes. Mainly the clothes.
Mods were modernists: sharp Italian suits, parkas to keep the suits clean on the scooter, and modern jazz, then soul and ska. Rockers wanted rock and roll, leather and speed.

sc_mod.text: That's a Vespa outside. Lambrettas are for show-offs. Don't tell the Ace Face I said that.

sc_rocker.text: I only come in for the coffee. And the jukebox. And the warm. Don't make a thing of it.
